name: Carpal Instability - Midcarpal
definition: Dynamic or static instability involving abnormal motion between proximal and distal carpal rows, producing pain, clunking or weakness.

investigations.principle: Dynamic radiographs, fluoroscopy and MRI/arthroscopy are selected according to suspected instability.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent symptomatic mechanical instability may require hand-surgery reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-Sandhi instability phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Dynamic or static instability involving abnormal motion between proximal and distal carpal rows, producing pain, clunking or weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
